title: Are Lab-Grown Diamonds Worth It?
audience: Couples in their 30s, affluent, interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences beyond that, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: Keyword given with a leading space; trimmed to 'lab grown diamonds'.
Fast mode: 02, 03 and 04 in parallel after the brief; 5 SERP cities; editor and readers in parallel; one combined final pass.

'Worth it' without prices: qualitative, sourced answers only (physical sameness, grading and disclosure, general relative cost and resale statements where a reputable source says so, environmental claims only where sourced with the FTC caution). No figures, percentages or 'save X'. Balanced 'worth it if / think twice if'. Link the ring budget article.
Confirm GIA's current lab-grown report format (flagged unconfirmed in the diamond buying guide) and Australian disclosure guidance (ACCC/ACL).
Overlap: diamond buying guide has a natural vs lab-grown section; this post goes deeper on the decision. SEO decides which page targets 'lab grown vs natural diamond'.
Never call lab-grown 'fake' or natural the only 'real' option. No jeweller names; GIA/IGI as labs, FTC/ACCC as regulators.
Firecrawl out of credits: use Apify web-fetch, DataForSEO on_page_instant_pages or search summaries, and record which.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; business details deferred.
